1: Sprint: 5–8 core bullets total, at most 14 words each; no examples or background.
2: Brief: merge pages into themes; 2–4 parallel bullets per section, 12–18 total, at most 16 words each; no long paragraphs.
3: Standard: 3–6 thematic sections; 2–5 short bullets per section; cover definitions, principles, formulas and steps; add page links.
4: Detailed: 3–6 thematic sections; 3–6 bullets per section; add conditions, pitfalls, concise examples; use short paragraphs (max 2 sentences) only when needed.
5: Deep dive: thematic sections; 3–7 bullets each; background, comparisons, derivation steps and traps; end with 3 self-test questions. Keep bullets terse.
